name: IdealMedia NAP Manager
author: Ideal Media Pro

sections.description:
IdealMedia NAP Manager helps local businesses display their Name, Address, and Phone number consistently across their WordPress site — and adds structured data that helps search engines understand your business information. Maintained by Ideal Media Pro, a web design and local SEO agency specializing in flat-rate websites for home service businesses.

Why NAP consistency matters

Search engines use your business name, address, and phone number to verify your location and rank you in local search. When this information is inconsistent or missing across your site, your local search rankings suffer.

Features

  • Central settings page for all your NAP data
  • Shortcode [ideanama_nap] — paste into any post or page
  • LocalBusiness schema markup automatically added to your page head
  • Clean output with microdata
  • Optional “Powered by” credit link
  • No external dependencies, no tracking, no bloat

About the Developer

This plugin is actively maintained by Ideal Media Pro. We build custom-coded, conversion-optimized websites and local SEO infrastructure for contractors, plumbers, HVAC companies, roofers, and home service businesses nationwide.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate through the Plugins screen
  3. Go to Settings → NAP Manager and enter your business details
  4. Use the [ideanama_nap] shortcode anywhere you want the NAP block to appear
sections.faq:
Where do I enter my business information?

Go to Settings → NAP Manager. Enter your business name, address, phone, and any other details.

How do I display the NAP block on my site?

Use the shortcode [ideanama_nap] in any post, page, or widget area.

Does this add schema markup to my site?

Yes. When enabled in Settings, the plugin adds LocalBusiness structured data to the head of every page.

Who maintains this plugin?

This open-source plugin is developed and maintained by Ideal Media Pro, a digital agency that builds high-performance web systems, local SEO schemas, and flat-rate website packages for home service businesses.
